reason: Conditional Starfall has a targeted resolution effect; target must be declared before milling. Active generated ResolveCard asks for a target only during conditional resolution. Four-live UPF has multiple opposing heroes, so the official single-opponent default cannot repair the omitted declaration. Do not record this unreviewed four-live packet.

official_evidence.scope: Default Decisions explicitly uses Astral Bridge pre-mill target; no default where several opposing heroes exist. Current page heading5.14, not an assumed stable numbered5.12.
5.1.4a declare legal targets when playing, including targeted conditional resolution effects.

source.boundary: ResolveCard starts by mill; STARFALL conditional and later MZCHOOSE are resolution decisions, not declaration.

limits: Source-supported known declaration family, not a new native failure or root attribution.
